summary: TradeOS Phase 2 (Company Knowledge Engine) verified end-to-end via Playwright UI test. All 10 acceptance criteria from the review request PASS. Login as Scott Marshall (inbox@twofungis.ca) → landed on /app/command-center → navigated to /app/estimating. ProductionLibraryPage renders with data-testid='production-library-page'. H1 = 'Production Library', subtitle = 'Company Knowledge Engine'. AI insight banner 'Company Brain learns from your Production Library' present (count=1). All 8 tabs (tab-library, tab-assemblies, tab-scopes, tab-labour, tab-pricing, tab-templates, tab-imports, tab-builder) render correctly. tab-builder carries the disabled attribute and a 'Soon' badge; clicking it does not switch the active tab (library remains active with bg-emerald-500/20 class). Empty state on Production Library tab shows 'Build Your Production Library' heading with 'Add First Production Item' button. Clicking the button opens the ProductionItemModal (data-testid='production-item-modal'). Company Brain button in header (data-testid='company-brain-btn') opens the V2 panel with an emerald-tinted header (bg-emerald-500/5), and all four sections render: Company Brief, Conversation (via 'Start a conversation with Company Brain' placeholder), Suggested Actions, Action History. Zero gold/yellow/amber-500/20 references in the brain panel container - V2 emerald design language fully applied. Old EstimatingPage.jsx has been removed from the codebase (find returned no results). App.js routes /app/estimating and /app/production-library to ProductionLibraryPage.

integration_issues.flow: Workspace context fetch on app entry
integration_issues.issue: Console shows repeated 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' from AppLayout.fetchWorkspaceContext and useOrganization on first render. Does not impact Production Library rendering, but the fetch appears to race with auth-token readiness. This is a pre-existing issue carried over from iteration 8 - NOT introduced by Phase 2 changes.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Investigate the pre-existing 'Failed to fetch' error on /api/workspace/context and useOrganization at initial render - retry-on-auth-ready would eliminate console noise. Not blocking Phase 2 acceptance.
OPTIONAL: When backend tables for Production Library are added in next iteration, replace localStorage placeholders in ProductionLibraryPage.jsx (lines 613-624) with real Supabase queries.

MINOR BUG (pre-existing behaviour but worth flagging): In ProductionLibraryPage.jsx line 775, localStorage.setItem is called with the stale productionItems state (before the setState update batches). New items are correctly rendered on screen but the persisted localStorage payload may lag by one item after a fresh add. Consider calling localStorage.setItem inside a useEffect on productionItems, or persist the updated array explicitly.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductionLibraryPage.jsx line 775: `localStorage.setItem('tradeos_production_items', JSON.stringify(productionItems))` is called with STALE state - the setProductionItems above uses functional updater but reads the state variable directly on the next line. Persistence will be off by one item on new adds. Refactor to persist inside useEffect([productionItems]) or pass the computed next array.

ProductionLibraryPage.jsx imports several icons that are declared but unused (Filter, Sparkles, Tag, FolderOpen, Zap, TrendingUp on some paths, Copy, Edit, Trash2). Dead imports increase bundle size and clutter code. Run eslint --fix or purge.
ProductionLibraryPage.jsx uses `API_URL = process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL` but never uses it (all data comes from localStorage). Remove until backend calls are wired up.

TabNavigation places the 'Soon' badge inside the button while also setting disabled - good pattern. However the button's `onClick={() => !tab.comingSoon && onTabChange(tab.id)}` is redundant when disabled is set at the DOM level. Cleanup: keep only the disabled attribute.
ImportsTab buttons currently just toast 'X import coming soon' - MOCKED. When backend is ready this needs a real CSV parser and upload endpoint.

CompanyBrainPanel.jsx: comment says 'Emerald accent palette (not gold)' - verified visually. However line 45 still uses `text-amber-400` for the 'estimate' context and line 270 uses `bg-amber-500/20` for medium-priority actions. This is amber (not gold), but if the intent is a fully emerald palette, consider aligning these accent shades too.
